autonomy.rule: T1 playbooks may merge with 1 human approver.
T3 playbooks block on intake; human owns fix.
Critical severity always requires the security lead in the approver stack.

recovery.rule: Auto-rollback if regression matrix drops below 100% within 30 min of merge.
Auto-rollback on any error-rate spike > 2x baseline.
Budget breach (>110% of estimate) pauses agent and asks human.

audit.rule: Every gate decision logged with evidence pointer.
Approver identity captured via SSO assertion.
Playbook diff preview must be visible at approval time.

release-gates.rule: Tests must pass on the target branch head.
No new high/critical findings introduced by the fix.
Side-effect probes green for adjacent endpoints.
Backup approver available for crypto-touching changes.
release-gates.rationale: From retro: single approver became blocker on SEC-1689 over the weekend.
